name: Same-Day Check-In
description: Walks a patient through same-day check-in at a clinic front desk: confirms identity by full name and date of birth against the patient record, confirms today's scheduled appointment, collects consent to treatment, and confirms intake forms. Use for requests like 'I'm here for my appointment', 'I'd like to check in', or when a patient states their name and date of birth to check in. Not for scheduling or rescheduling a new appointment, not for looking up insurance coverage details, not for general facility/hours/billing questions (use the FAQ agent), and not for anything requiring identity verification beyond name and date of birth (no ID card or camera scanning support).
example_requests: hi, I'm here to check in, my name is Sarah Johnson
can you check me in for today's visit
